**To:** Dana Whitfield, General Counsel, Tamarack Instruments
**Re:** Executive Briefing Proposal

## Situation Summary

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has deployed a customer service chatbot on its support portal, is piloting AI visual inspection on the German production line and plans AI sales forecasting next year. Your stated objective is to have governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027. A June 2026 internal audit finding recorded no inventory of AI systems. ISO/IEC 42001 work is expected to start next year, though the start date is not fixed.

## What the Briefing Covers for Tamarack Instruments

The Briefing maps the EU AI Act and GDPR to your three use cases. These are expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice.

* **Chatbot:** We review transparency expectations toward users and the handling of customer data, including the stated constraint that customer data stay in the EU.
* **Visual inspection:** We examine how risk classification under the EU AI Act may apply to a production system.
* **United States:** No US driver is listed, so US matters appear only as general landscape items.

We then outline a governance operating model using the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). Board-level considerations draw on AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards).

We also discuss how the inventory finding and the incumbent ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 9001 frameworks may bear on ISO/IEC 42001 preparation. We make no promise of certification or audit outcomes. Because the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff, that consultation becomes a decision point for the inspection timeline. Throughout, we apply three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

## Logistics and Price

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session for executive leadership and board-level attendees. The price is US$3,000. The roles listed for the audience are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. Session date: Unknown.

## What You Receive Afterward

After the session you receive a written summary memo. It records the decisions surfaced, readiness observations and three prioritized recommendations. Each recommendation is mapped to a possible next program option with its price, duration and a proposed timeline.

## Next Step

Your decision is expected by 15 December 2026. We suggest confirming a session date and the final attendee list before then. On your approval we will send scheduling options.

Kind regards,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
